errors.text: The formula ActionLivePropD at line 29, col 5 to line 29, col 15 of module ActionLevelProp is an action-level formula (i.e., it contains no temporal operators). Only temporal-level (or state-level) formulas are allowed under PROPERTY or PROPERTIES. To check that action ActionLivePropD holds in *every* step of the behavior, define a temporal property by applying the "always" temporal operator ([]) to the formula at line 29, col 5 to line 29, col 15 of module ActionLevelProp (compare page 90 of Specifying Systems at https://lamport.azurewebsites.net/tla/book.html).
